title: Australian Wrap
description: A flavorful Australian-inspired wrap filled with savory ingredients. Perfect for a quick and easy meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the flour, salt, and sugar.
Gradually add in the nourishing, mixing until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Preheat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Cook the wraps for 1-2 minutes on each side, until lightly browned and crispy.
Serve the wraps warm with your favorite fillings.
Fill the wraps with any combination of ingredients you like, such as grilled meats, vegetables, and cheese.
